test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

The man said, "Be quiet and listen carefully."

options.text: The man said to be quiet and to listen carefully.
The man ordered them to be quiet and listen carefully.
The man asked to be quiet and listen.
The man advised them to be quiet.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The man ordered them to be quiet and listen carefully.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Be quiet and listen carefully" becomes "to be quiet and listen carefully"**
 
 
• The imperative mood in direct speech ("Be") is converted to an infinitive phrase ("to be") in indirect speech.
 
• The verb "listen" remains unchanged but is included in the infinitive phrase.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Direct: "said"
 
• Converted to: "ordered" to convey the tone of command.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is replaced with an indirect structure, removing quotation marks.
 
• The sentence is adjusted to reflect the tone of command.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The man ordered them to be quiet and listen carefully.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The man said to be quiet and to listen carefully."

 
 
• Does not accurately reflect the tone of command.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The man asked to be quiet and listen."
 
 
• The verb "asked" does not convey the commanding tone of the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The man advised them to be quiet."
 
 
• The verb "advised" changes the tone from a command to a suggestion.
